Instant; the reduction or escape lasts until the Grapple is reapplied.

The squeeze is passive. The Grapple reduction is a Maneuver.

Standard
Reduce your Grappled rating by 3.
Strong
You are free of the Grapple; your Grappled rating becomes 0.

You can squeeze through a gap wide enough for your head and shoulders at half Speed.
